opening.argument: The presentation ties earning potential directly to participant growth: it says, "the more you you help your teammates, the more you will grow," and illustrates earnings with two members and larger numbers of direct members. It also promotes packages containing tokens that can be exchanged or used to buy more mining space, while promising viewers the ability to "obtain unlimited profits" and to double their tokens and earnings. This is paired with an urgent recruitment call—"Don't wait any longer! Don't waste more time!"—and instructions to contact the group through a link or leader, presenting participation and recruitment as the route to extraordinary returns.
